h: The Tribe of Levi Reveals the Light Within Torah

p: we say, "May His light rest upon it."
הוּא כְּלָלָא דְּכָל אוֹרַיְיתָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, א)
is the sum of the entire Torah (Zohar II 92a);
and in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 25) the wording is
that it is equal to all the mitzvos, etc.
כִּי נֵר מִצְוָה וְתוֹרָה אוֹר (מִשְׁלֵי ו, כג)
For "a mitzvah is a lamp and Torah is light" (Mishlei 6:23);
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu hid away for the righteous
And this was hidden in the Torah
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
and in Sefer HaBahir it is stated:
and placed it for them in its place,
and the rest He hid away for the righteous, etc.
which is the meal of Atika,
the aspect of the primordial light, we ask:
that they merit the hidden light permanently.
Now when Yisrael were counted, it is written,
וְהַלְוִיִּם לֹא הָתְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹכָם (בְּמִדְבַּר א, מז)
"But the Levi'im were not counted among them" (Bamidbar 1:47).
was not the purpose of the count
to know how many hosts of the Torah there were,
as written in the holy Zohar?
That is, every one of Yisrael
יֵשׁ לוֹ אוֹת אוֹ חֵלֶק מֵאוֹת בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרָה
has a letter or part of a letter in the Sefer Torah,
for the entire Torah is the sum of the souls,
as written in the sefarim, the allusion:
"there are six hundred thousand letters in the Torah."
that although the count is not exact,
such as the letter Lamed, Kaf, Vav,
וְאוֹת א׳ י׳ ו׳ י׳ וְכַדּוֹמֶה
and the letter Alef, Yud, Vav, Yud, and the like.
אוֹת אוֹ חֵלֶק מֵאוֹת בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרָה
is a letter or part of a letter in the Sefer Torah,
without which the Sefer Torah is invalid.
And since the Levi'im were not counted,
וְכִי לֹא הָיָה לָהֶם חֵלֶק בַּתּוֹרָה
did they, Heaven forbid, have no portion in the Torah?
Heaven forbid, and far be it to say so!
each one his portion in the Torah,
a letter or part of a letter,
that is, in the body of the Torah.
But the main thing is the light of Torah
"and enlighten our eyes in Your Torah"
that there shine in the heart
the utterance "I am Hashem your God";
this is the portion of the Levi'im.
For it is stated (Tanchuma, this parsha)
that the tribe of Levi was chosen
from all the tribes of Yisrael,
"And I chose him from all the tribes of Yisrael
לִי לְכֹהֵן וְגוֹ׳ (שְׁמוּאֵל א ב, כח)
to be a Kohen for Me" etc. (Shmuel I 2:28),
was the root of the holiness of the tribe of Levi,
since he was the Nasi of his tribe
and it is written, "For the lips of the Kohen
and they shall seek Torah from his mouth,
כִּי מַלְאַךְ ה׳ צְבָאוֹת הוּא (מַלְאָכִי ב, ז)
for he is an angel of Hashem of Hosts" (Malachi 2:7).
to seek Torah from his mouth
אַדְּרַבָּא הַתּוֹרָה נִתְּנָה רַק לִבְנֵי אָדָם
On the contrary, the Torah was given only to human beings,
and it has no connection to angels,
as Moshe Rabbeinu answered the angels,
But the body of the Torah,
that is, the 613 mitzvos in it,
נִקְרָא תַּרְיַ״ג זֵינֵי עֵיטָא לִבְנֵי נָשָׁא
are called the 613 kinds of counsel for people,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פב, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 82b);
אֶלָּא אוֹרַיְיתָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א)
Heaven forbid, the light of Torah,
that it shine in the heart;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה פָּרָשַׁת יִשָּׁקֵנִי)
that when Yisrael heard the utterance "Anochi,"
Torah study was implanted in their heart.
truly do not apply to angels,
as in the argument of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him:
"Is there a yetzer hara among you?"
But the essential light of Torah,
שֶׁיָּאִיר מַאֲמַר אָנֹכִי ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּלֵּב
that the utterance "I am Hashem your God" shine in the heart
this is what the angels wanted.
And this is what it says,
"For the lips of the Kohen shall guard knowledge":
Da'as is the inwardness of Keser Elyon,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רנו, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (III 256b):
"and they shall seek Torah from his mouth":
עַל וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹ׳ לְדוֹרֹתָם
on "And the Bnei Yisrael shall keep" etc. "throughout their generations":
fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,
so that the yetzer hara is cleared out from there.
And this is what it says,
"for he is an angel of Hashem of Hosts":
like an angel, who has no yetzer hara,
and so he can shine for all Yisrael
the light of the Torah into the heart.
And this is the holiness of the tribe of Levi.
And this is what it says,
"They shall teach Your ordinances to Yaakov" (Devarim 33:10):
that is, all the general rules and details of the Torah
called by the name "the house of Yaakov"
that is, to teach the heart
the light from the words of Torah,
the utterance "I am Hashem your God,"
that it be fixed in the heart, as mentioned above
and those who toil in Torah.
And since he is an angel,
his root is to attain Da'as,
And therefore the tribe of Levi was not counted
for their portion is the light of Torah.
And this is why it does not say,
"Raise the head of the sons of Levi,"
but only "Count the sons of Levi":
since their portion is the light of Torah,
the primordial light that was hidden,
they need no raising of the head.
Only when they were appointed to the service,
then it is written "naso es rosh"
with the sons of Gershon and the sons of Kehas;
and it does not write "sa es rosh"
and this is through the service of the Mishkan.
